# GEO Autopilot

> GEO Autopilot is a Generative Engine Optimization service: it audits how AI
> crawlers see a website, fixes what blocks them through a safety-gated
> publishing pipeline, benchmarks real buyer questions against AI search
> engines, and reports visibility as a five-stage measured funnel. Every
> change is backed up, verified live, and reversible; unmeasurable metrics
> are reported as unmeasurable, never estimated.

Contact: adamkrestol@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://webcrawlers.tech/): what the service does and what you get
- [What is GEO?](https://webcrawlers.tech/what-is-geo): definition, GEO vs SEO, and the measurable inputs that influence AI citations
- [How it works](https://webcrawlers.tech/how-it-works): the ten-stage pipeline mechanism, safety gates, and funnel measurement
- [FAQ](https://webcrawlers.tech/faq): honest answers, including what nobody can promise about AI search
